May fight with a two-handed weapon.
May fight with a weapon in each hand.

Base damage from successful melee and missile attacks is increased by +1 at 1st level and by an additional +1 at 3rd, 6th, 9th, and 12th level.

ability.name: battlefield_leadership
ability.summary: Personally led henchmen and mercenaries gain improved morale.

rules.rule: Any henchmen and mercenaries hired by the fighter gain a +1 bonus to morale when the fighter personally leads them.
This bonus stacks with modifiers from Charisma and proficiencies.

ability.name: castle_and_command
ability.summary: The fighter may build a castle and become a major military leader.

rules.rule: The fighter may build a castle if sufficient gold is available.
Building the castle allows the fighter to take a leadership rank in society.
Campaign rules for castles are referenced externally.

acquisition_rules.rule: May build a castle if sufficient gold is available.
May take a leadership rank in society after establishing the castle.

cost_rules.rule: If hired, followers must be paid standard mercenary rates.

core_statistics.post_max_hit_dice_rule: After 9 Hit Dice, gains +1 hit point per level through 14th level; Constitution hit point modifiers do not apply to these fixed increases.

weapons.rule: May use quarterstaffs, clubs, daggers, and darts.

restrictions.restriction: May not fight with two weapons.

combat_rules.rule: Attack throw against an unarmored foe (AC 0) is 10+ at 1st level.
Attack throws and saving throws improve by 2 points every 6 levels.

access_rules.rule: Can learn and cast arcane spells.
Daily spell use is limited by the spell slots shown in level progression.
Spell selection is limited to the mage's repertoire.

repertoire_rules.rule: The repertoire can include a number of spells up to the number and level of spells listed for the mage's level, increased by the mage's Intelligence bonus.

ritual_access.rule: At 11th level, may learn and cast ritual arcane spells of 7th, 8th, and 9th level.

casting_limits.rule: Only spells in the repertoire may be cast.

ability.name: spell_research_scrolls_and_potions
ability.summary: Unlocks research and lesser magical item creation.

rules.rule: May research spells.
May scribe magical scrolls.
May brew potions.

ability.name: major_magic_item_creation
ability.summary: Unlocks creation of more powerful magic items.

rules.rule: May create magic items such as weapons, rings, and staffs.

ability.name: advanced_arcane_creation
ability.summary: Unlocks high-end ritual and magical creation options.

rules.rule: May craft magical constructs.
May create magical cross-breeds.
If chaotic, may create necromantic servants and become undead.

acquisition_rules.rule: May build a sanctum, often a great tower.
If the mage builds a dungeon beneath or near the tower, monsters will start to arrive to dwell within, followed shortly by adventurers seeking to fight them.

cost_rules.rule: Apprentices and seekers must be provided food and lodging, but need not be paid wages.

loyalty_or_morale_rules.rule: Their Intelligence scores are above average, but many become discouraged and quit after 1d6 months.

general_notes.rule: The source includes a pre-generated priest template. If the cleric's INT is 13 or greater, one or more additional general proficiencies may be selected before play, subject to the Starting Proficiencies rules.

weapons.rule: Weapons permitted are determined by the strictures of the cleric's religious order.
If no religious orders are specified, the default cleric is assumed to worship Ammonar and may use only blunt weapons such as warhammers, maces, clubs, quarterstaffs, and slings.

fighting_styles.rule: May use two-handed weapons if permitted by the order.

restrictions.restriction: Default Ammonar clerics may not use blood-shedding weapons.
Default Ammonar clerics may not fight with a weapon in each hand.

combat_rules.rule: Attack throw against an unarmored foe (AC 0) is 10+ at 1st level.
Attack throws and saving throws improve by 2 points every 4 levels.

access_rules.rule: Beginning at 2nd level, may manifest divine spells granted through prayer and worship.
Number and level of divine spells available are determined by level progression.

ritual_access.rule: At 11th level, may learn and cast ritual divine spells of 6th and 7th level.

casting_limits.rule: To use spells and turn undead, the cleric must uphold the doctrines of the faith and deity.
If the cleric falls from favor by violating doctrine or clergy rules, the Judge may impose penalties, including attack penalties or reduced spells available.

turning.definition: Call upon divine power to turn away, destroy, or in some chaotic sects control undead.

rules.rule: Turning potency depends on cleric level and undead type.
On the turning table, "-" means the cleric is too low level to affect that undead type.
"T" means the undead are automatically turned.
"D" means the undead are automatically destroyed.
A numbered entry means the player must roll that number or higher on 1d20 to turn the undead.
On a successful numeric turning attempt, or on a "T" result, roll 2d6; the total equals the total Hit Dice of undead turned.
On a "D" result, roll 2d6; the total equals the total Hit Dice of undead destroyed.
At least one undead monster is always turned or destroyed on a successful use of turning, regardless of the 2d6 total.
There is no daily limit on attempts to turn undead.
If an attempt to turn undead fails during an encounter, the cleric cannot attempt to turn undead again for the rest of that encounter.
Turned undead flee for 10 rounds by the best and fastest means available.
If turned undead cannot flee, they cower, take no actions, and suffer a -2 penalty to AC.
If the cleric attacks turned undead in melee, the turning effect ends.
The cleric may use spells or missile weapons against turned undead without breaking the effect.
Other characters may attack turned undead in any fashion without breaking the effect.
Destroyed undead are immediately reduced to ash.
Certain chaotic sects control undead instead of turning them.
Controlled undead last for 1 turn per cleric level, or 1 day per cleric level if the result would have destroyed them.
Controlled undead behave as if charmed and obey the cleric as friends.
If controlled undead are turned or destroyed by a cleric before control ends, the control ends immediately.
If control ends naturally, the undead flee as if turned.
Infernal includes very powerful undead or unholy beings such as demons and devils.

procedure.step: Consult the turning table for the undead type and cleric level.
If the result is "-", the attempt cannot affect that undead type.
If the result is a number, roll 1d20 and succeed on that number or higher.
If the result is "T", skip the 1d20 roll and resolve turning automatically.
If the result is "D", skip the 1d20 roll and resolve destruction automatically.
Roll 2d6 to determine the total Hit Dice affected.
Apply the effect to at least one undead on a successful result, even if the 2d6 total would otherwise be insufficient.

rules.rule: May research spells.
May scribe scrolls.
May brew potions.

ability.name: major_magic_item_creation
ability.summary: Unlocks creation of more powerful magic items.

rules.rule: May create magic items such as weapons, rings, and staffs.

ability.name: advanced_divine_creation
ability.summary: Unlocks high-end ritual and magical creation options.

rules.rule: May craft magical constructs such as golems and animated statues.
If chaotic, may create necromantic servants and become undead.

acquisition_rules.rule: May establish or build a fortified church.
If currently in favor with the deity, may buy or build the fortified church at half the normal price due to divine intervention.

cost_rules.rule: Followers must be provided food and lodging, but need not be paid wages.

loyalty_or_morale_rules.rule: Followers are completely loyal and have morale +4.
The Judge determines the proportions of archers, infantry, and other soldier types.

core_statistics.post_max_hit_dice_rule: After 9 Hit Dice, gains +2 hit points per level through 14th level; Constitution hit point modifiers do not apply to these fixed increases.

general_notes.rule: A thief will usually belong to a Thieves' Guild in the local town.
At the Judge's discretion, a thief may have to forfeit part of earnings to the guild in exchange for protection.

weapons.rule: May use any one-handed melee weapons.

fighting_styles.rule: May fight with a one-handed weapon in each hand.
May wield a one-handed weapon with two hands.

restrictions.restriction: May not wear armor heavier than leather.
May not use exclusively two-handed melee weapons such as great axes or polearms.

combat_rules.rule: Attack throw against an unarmored foe (AC 0) is 10+ at 1st level.
Attack throws and saving throws improve by 2 points every 4 levels.

rules.rule: Thief skills improve by level according to the thief skills table.
When a thief uses a listed skill, roll 1d20 as a proficiency throw.
The Judge will usually make these rolls because the thief is not always aware of failure.
After applying relevant modifiers, success occurs when the result is greater than or equal to the target value for the thief's level and the relevant skill.
A roll of 20 is always a success.
A roll of 1 is always a failure.

skill.name: open_locks
skill.rule: Requires thieves' tools.
May attempt to pick a particular mechanical lock only once.
If the attempt fails, the thief cannot try that same lock again until reaching a higher experience level.
The Judge may apply modifiers based on the complexity of the lock.

skill.name: find_and_remove_traps
skill.rule: Through careful inspection and probing, the thief may find hidden traps and attempt to disable or discharge them harmlessly.
The thief may attempt to find or remove a trap only once in a given area.
Finding a trap and removing a trap are separate applications; the trap must be found before it can be removed.
The Judge may apply modifiers based on the complexity of the trap.
If the attempt fails, the thief cannot try again until reaching a higher experience level.

skill.name: pick_pockets
skill.rule: If the throw is less than half the target value, the intended victim notices the attempt.
If noticed, the Judge makes a reaction roll with a -3 penalty to determine the victim's reaction.
Apply a -1 penalty to the proficiency throw for each level the thief is lower than the victim.

skill.name: move_silently
skill.rule: On success, the thief moves with total silence.
The thief always believes the attempt succeeded until others react.
Moving silently at up to one-half normal combat movement causes no penalty.
Moving faster than one-half speed applies a -5 penalty to the throw.
Running applies a -10 penalty to the throw.

skill.name: climb_walls
skill.rule: Requires one proficiency throw for each 100 feet climbed.
If the throw fails, the thief falls a distance equal to half the attempted distance, plus the distance already covered by any previous successful throws.
Falling damage is 1d6 per 10 feet.
Climbing speed is one-quarter normal combat movement.

skill.name: hide_in_shadows
skill.rule: The thief may attempt to remain unseen in darkness.
The thief always believes the attempt succeeded until others react.
The thief remains hidden only while motionless.
If the thief moves, a new proficiency throw is required.

skill.name: hear_noise
skill.rule: The thief may listen in caves, hallways, at doors, and similar locations.
The thief must be quiet and in a quiet environment.

ability.name: backstab
ability.summary: Attack an unaware opponent for improved accuracy and multiplied damage.

triggers.trigger: Target is unaware of the thief's presence, whether by surprise or by the thief moving silently and/or hiding in shadows to approach.

rules.rule: The backstab attack gains a +4 bonus to the attack throw.
If successful, damage is multiplied by level band.
Levels 1-4 deal double normal damage.
Levels 5-8 deal triple normal damage.
Levels 9-12 deal quadruple normal damage.
Levels 13+ deal quintuple normal damage.

ability.name: read_languages
ability.summary: Read languages, ciphers, treasure maps, and dead languages.

rules.rule: Requires a proficiency throw of 5+ on 1d20.
Does not apply to magical writings.
If the throw fails, the thief cannot attempt to read that particular writing again until reaching a higher experience level.

ability.name: arcane_scroll_use
ability.summary: Read and cast magic from arcane scrolls.

rules.rule: Requires a proficiency throw of 3+ on 1d20.
If the throw fails, the spell does not function as expected and may create a harmful effect at the Judge's discretion.

acquisition_rules.rule: A successful character may use followers to start a Thieves' Guild.

cost_rules.rule: If hired, apprentices must be paid standard rates for ruffians.
